description_en: Retrieves files and their summary information from a specified knowledge base
description_zh: 获取指定知识库中的文件，以及它们的概要信息
name: ListIndexDocuments

parameters.help_en: The knowledge base ID, which is the `Data.Id` returned by the CreateIndex operation
parameters.help_zh: 知识库 ID，即 CreateIndex 接口返回的`Data.Id`
parameters.name: index_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters the returned file list by file import status. Valid values:
INSERT_ERROR: failed to import to the index.
RUNNING: index building in progress.
DELETED: deleted.
FINISH: index building succeeded.
PARSE_FAILED: parsing failed.
DOC_PARSING: parsing in progress.

Default value: empty, which means no filtering by file import status
parameters.help_zh:
即通过文件导入状态对接口返回的文件列表进行过滤。取值范围：
INSERT_ERROR：导入索引失败。
RUNNING：索引构建中。
DELETED：已经删除。
FINISH：索引构建成功。
PARSE_FAILED：解析失败
DOC_PARSING：解析中

默认值为空，即不使用文件导入状态对结果进行过滤
parameters.name: document_status

parameters.help_en: Filters the returned file list by file name (without the file extension). Default value: empty, which means no filtering by file name
parameters.help_zh: 即通过文件名称（不含后缀）对接口返回的文件列表进行过滤。默认值为空，即不使用文件名称对结果进行过滤
parameters.name: document_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable fuzzy matching for file names. This parameter is used together with the `DocumentName` parameter. Valid values:
true: Performs fuzzy matching on the returned file list based on the file name.
false: Performs exact matching on the returned file list based on the file name.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启文件名称的模糊匹配，与`DocumentName`参数配合使用。取值范围：
true：根据文件名称对接口返回的文件列表进行模糊匹配。
false：默认根据文件名称进行精确匹配。

默认值为false
parameters.name: enable_name_like

parameters.help_en: The page number. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的页码。起始值为1。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of files to display per page in a paged query. No maximum limit.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时每页展示的文件数量。最大值不限。
默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID of the knowledge base. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

Data.description_en: The data field returned by the operation

Documents.description_en: The list of files in the knowledge base, sorted by document import time in descending order (consistent with the console)
Documents.description_zh: 返回知识库中的文件列表，按文档导入时间倒序排序（与控制台一致）

Code.description_en: The error status code for file import

DocumentType.description_en: The file format type. Valid values: pdf, docx, doc, txt, md, pptx, ppt, png, jpg, jpeg, bmp, gif, and EXCEL
DocumentType.description_zh: 文件格式类型。可能值为： pdf、docx、doc、txt、md、pptx、ppt、png、jpg、jpeg、bmp、gif、EXCEL

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the file was imported to the knowledge base, in UNIX timestamp format
GmtModified.description_zh: 文件导入知识库的时间，采用Unix timestamp格式

Message.description_en: The error message for file import
Message.example: check fileUrlKey[file_path] / fileNameKey[null] / fileExtensionKey[file_extension] is invalid

SourceId.description_en:
<props="china">

For document search or audio/video search knowledge bases, this parameter specifies the category ID, which is the `CategoryId` returned by the AddCategory operation. You can also obtain it by clicking the ID icon next to the category name on the Files tab of Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center).


For data query or image Q&A knowledge bases, this parameter specifies the data table ID. You can obtain it by clicking the ID icon next to the data table name on the Tables tab of Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center).


</props>

<props="intl">

</props>
